evidence.assessment: Independent inspection of full images 97 and 98 and continuous enlarged strips shows a blackened page carrying the surviving 3.12 region, an intervening blank support leaf with Desunt hic quaedam, and the next surviving verse text on image 98. Readable rows there include crimina pone tuo, identifying 3.14; the later Ex XIII. eleg. label does not override that identification. Chatelain’s manuscript description explicitly lists transmission through 3.12.26 and resumption at 3.14.3, independently supporting the exact canonical boundary. Neither the number of originally lost leaves nor a historical cause is inferred. This supports the absence of canonical3.13.1–36; missing annotations alone were not used as evidence.
